definitions.explanation: The collective term for cereal grains such as rice, wheat, barley, and corn. Used in food, agriculture, and nutrition contexts.

examples.japanese: {穀類|こくるい}は{主食|しゅしょく}として{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: Grains are important as a staple food.

examples.japanese: {穀類|こくるい}の{価格|かかく}が{上昇|じょうしょう}している。
{健康|けんこう}のために、{精製|せいせい}されていない{穀類|こくるい}を{多|おお}く{取|と}るようにしている。
examples.english: For my health, I try to eat more unrefined grains.

notes:
A general term encompassing cereal grains — {米|こめ} (rice), {麦|むぎ} (wheat/barley), {玉蜀黍|とうもろこし} (corn), {粟|あわ} (millet), etc. Commonly used in nutrition labels, agricultural reports, and food science. In everyday conversation, specific grain names are more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {穀類|こくるい}を{食|た}べる — to eat grains
- {全粒|ぜんりゅう}{穀類|こくるい} — whole grains
- {穀類|こくるい}の{生産|せいさん} — grain production
- {穀類|こくるい}の{価格|かかく} — grain prices

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {穀物|こくもつ} — grain, cereal; very similar meaning, slightly more common in general contexts
- {雑穀|ざっこく} — miscellaneous grains (millet, sorghum, etc.); grains other than rice and wheat
- {主食|しゅしょく} — staple food; broader category that includes grains but also potatoes, bread, etc.
